knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A possible puncture requires an immediate stop, the protocol and a clinical referral.
Graphic detail beyond the operational need is not required.

practicalCriteria: In a simulated incident, the learner records the time, the exposure details, the escalation and the referral. Pass: all four are recorded in the simulated record.
The learner writes a short wellbeing offer that makes clear the worker can stop. Pass: the offer includes confidential support and the right to stop.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A worker is pressured to continue after an exposure.
